Police search for man accused of breaking into Beatrice home

Actual Article Body:
BEATRICE, Neb. (KOLN) - The Beatrice Police Department is searching for a man who forcibly entered a home Saturday morning.

According to police, an unidentified man entered a home near 12th and Washington streets in Beatrice and left after being confronted. He later returned and kicked in the door to get inside.

Police are asking residents in the area to review their security camera footage for any suspicious activity around 4 a.m. The man was last seen leaving the area going east.

Beatrice police also released camera footage of the suspect on their Facebook page. You can view the video here.

Anyone with information is being asked to contact the Beatrice Police Department’s nonemergency number at 402-223-4080.
